module: Module 4: Order Execution, Modification & Bulk Routing
title: Out-of-Order Execution Report Handling
precondition: High network congestion causes Child Order #4 fill report to arrive after Child Order #5.
expected_result: MAM event bus re-sequences messages using sequential tick sequence numbers; avoids race condition or state corruption.
actual_result: OMS event bus utilizes sequential tick IDs and idempotency tracking to re-sequence out-of-order execution reports.
